lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: I promised to come home. Keeping a promise takes practice.

description: A sailor who treats practice as part of keeping a promise to come home. His battle is optional. A modest personal commitment gives the challenge a reason without turning it into a progression gate.

sections: §30: working harbour, optional sailors and the planned island crossing.
